title: Ndzhwalo Lowu Tiseke Ku Horisa
intro: Moya-xiviri lowu ringiweke ku tlula mpimo wu tekeriwe nchavelelo, vanghana ni matimba ya miri. Hi ku tihambanisa ni nhlomulo lowukulu, nandza loyi wa Allah u hundzukele ntsena eka Vukwembu. Hi ku lehisa mbilu loku nga tsekatsekiki ni xikhongelo lexi humaka embilwini, ku fike xidzedze xa tintswalo lexi tlulaka hinkwaswo leswi a swi languteriwile. I mani xifaniso lexi lexi ku tinyiketela ka xona ku pfuleke nyangwa wa ku vuyeteriwa?
clues: A ndzi ri nandza la tsakeriwaka wa Allah, a ndzi tiphina hi ku tala, muti lowu humelelaka ni rihanyo lerinene emasikwini ya mina.
Kutani ndzingo wu rhelela: rifuwo ri fambile, varhandziwa va fambile, nyama ya mina yi hlaseriwe hi ku xaniseka lokukulu.
Lava a va ri ekusuhi na mina a va nga swi koti ku tiyisela xiyimo xa mina, naswona ndzi sale ndzi ri ndzexe, miri wa mina wu tshovekile hi ku xaniseka.
Ndzi vitanile Hosi ya mina, ndzi tivisa leswaku Sathana u ndzi khumbile hi ku karhala ni ku xupuriwa.
Nhlamulo yi tile — xileriso xo ba misava hi nenge wa mina, naswona eka yona ku khuluka mati yo kufumela leswaku ma horisa.
Hosi ya mina yi susile ku nonon’hweriwa hi ku helela kutani yi vuyisela ndyangu wa mina eka mina, wu andza, tanihi xikombiso xa tintswalo eka lava va anakanyisisaka.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verse: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. (38:43)
